title: A Salt for the Sigil
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
